title: runner.json: one playthrough's runner state and play history (unversioned)
description: <runtime>/sessions/<playthrough>/runner.json. Written by play.py's runner (bg3harness.runner.state.RunnerState: save owner, quicksaves, loaded save, mod hashes ...) and by the app (bg3play.adapters.harness_runner.append_history: one play row per session; bg3harness.game.host.AppHost: loaded_save). Every writer keeps the keys it doesn't own. No `v` field yet: play.py and the app share the file until Phase D retires play.py, and old files must keep parsing. This schema pins what the readers use (bg3play.store, the runner's policy); other keys are free.

kind.description: absent = "play" (old files); readers use only play rows

reason.description: why it ended: exited, milestone, cap, hang, crash, aborted ...
